additional_sources.title: Centrica Storage: 2024 Annual Environmental Performance - Rough Offshore Facilities
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report explicitly states Rough Offshore Facilities produced 6,619 tCO2e during 2024. Offshore facility scope is retained and blocked from England cadastral parcel promotion.

additional_sources.title: Equinor UK Limited: 2024 OSPAR Offshore Environmental Performance Report - Mariner
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted Figure 15 exposes explicit Mariner A and Mariner B atmospheric-emission values for CO2, N2O and CH4. CO2 is reported in kte and is preserved in reported units with a separate normalized-tonnes field; offshore geometry blocks parcel promotion.

additional_sources.title: TAQA UK: Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted Table 1 reports 2024 full-year CO2 total of 590,296 tonnes for TAQA UK operated assets versus ETS allowances. Portfolio total is retained without facility or cadastral inference.

additional_sources.title: TotalEnergies E&P UK: Annual Environmental Statement 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report contains 2024 facility CO2e graphs and independently verified UK ETS context. Exact facility values are not machine-readable, so no graph-axis estimate or measured row is created.

additional_sources.title: Spirit Energy: OSPAR Environmental Performance Review 2024
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted page 11 visually shows 2024 GHG totals by operated installation/facility and source, but exact bar values are not printed; screenshot is retained as evidence and no axis-based numeric inference is promoted.

additional_sources.title: Harbour Energy: UK North Sea Region 2024 Annual Environmental Statement
additional_sources.guard: Official OPRED-hosted report presents 2024 UK ETS CO2 and PPC atmospheric-emission charts by asset. Machine-readable text does not expose reliable asset values, therefore no chart-derived numeric row is promoted.

guard_contract.MEASUREMENT_CANDIDATE: Reported or monitored source data requires explicit scope or facility, pollutant/gas, quantity, unit, period and method provenance. Graph-only values are never estimated. Offshore measurements remain facility, activity or portfolio level and cannot become England cadastral parcel values.
guard_contract.BINDING_CANDIDATE: Permit or facility data supports identity/binding only; no emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SPATIAL_CANDIDATE: Map/grid/boundary data supports spatial matching only; no measured emissions quantity is implied.
guard_contract.SOURCE_UPGRADE: Collection, guidance, aggregate or ambiguous-layout records cannot become parcel GHG without compatible observed quantity and verified parcel geometry.

web_research_basis: Fresh official GOV.UK/OPRED research on 2026-07-27. Six additional annual environmental-report surfaces were deduplicated against batches 169-179. Centrica, Equinor and TAQA contain explicit numeric rows; TotalEnergies, Spirit and Harbour remain source-only where exact graph values are not printed. Screenshot attempts were made for all analysed PDF graph/table pages; Spirit succeeded while other government PDF screenshot calls returned cache/internal errors. No OCR or chart inference was used.
